WITH ham AS (
  SELECT drv_main, (driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date AS birth
  FROM drivers
  WHERE driver_identity->'name'->>'first_name' = 'Lewis' AND driver_identity->'name'->>'surname' = 'Hamilton'
), ppr AS (
  SELECT ds.rlink AS race_id, h.birth,
    ds.acc_pt / COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY to_date(r.event_schedule->>'date_set','YYYY/MM/DD'), ds.rlink
                               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ppr,
    to_date(r.event_schedule->>'date_set','YYYY/MM/DD') AS race_date
  FROM driver_standings ds JOIN ham h ON h.drv_main = ds.drive_link
  JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = ds.rlink
)
SELECT race_id, ppr / FLOOR((CURRENT_DATE - birth) / 365.25) AS dpv
FROM ppr
ORDER BY race_date, race_id

SELECT r.yr AS year, r.rak_id AS race_id, c.namelabel AS constructor_name,
  SUM(cr.scoreval) OVER w
  * (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.st_mark IS NULL) OVER w)::numeric / COUNT(*) OVER w AS cumulative_cps
FROM constructor_results cr
JOIN constructors c ON c.cstr_key = cr.unitnode
JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = cr.matchref
WHERE c.namelabel = 'McLaren'
WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY r.yr ORDER BY r.rnum, r.rak_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
ORDER BY r.yr, r.rnum, r.rak_id

SELECT location_metadata->>'name' AS circuit_name,
  (location_metadata->'coordinates'->>'elevation_m')::numeric AS elevation
FROM circuits
WHERE (location_metadata->'coordinates'->>'elevation_m')::numeric > 800
ORDER BY elevation DESC

SELECT r.event_schedule->>'event_name' AS event_name,
  d.driver_identity->>'reference' AS driver_reference,
  (9 - (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int) + (s.sprint_performance->>'points')::numeric AS sprint_performance_index
FROM sprint_results s
JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = s.matchref
JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = s.unitdrive
WHERE s.sprint_performance->>'final_position' IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sprint_performance_index DESC

SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(to_date(r.event_schedule->>'date_set', 'YYYY/MM/DD'),
                                 (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date))) AS average_age
FROM sprint_results s
JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = s.matchref
JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = s.unitdrive
WHERE (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG((9 - (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int) + (sprint_performance->>'points')::numeric), 2) AS avg_spi
FROM sprint_results
WHERE (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int <= 8

WITH q AS (
  SELECT rbind, pilotrec,
    CASE WHEN q1_r ~ '^\d+:\d+(\.\d+)?$' THEN split_part(q1_r,':',1)::numeric*60 + split_part(q1_r,':',2)::numeric END AS t1,
    CASE WHEN q2_r ~ '^\d+:\d+(\.\d+)?$' THEN split_part(q2_r,':',1)::numeric*60 + split_part(q2_r,':',2)::numeric END AS t2,
    CASE WHEN q3_r ~ '^\d+:\d+(\.\d+)?$' THEN split_part(q3_r,':',1)::numeric*60 + split_part(q3_r,':',2)::numeric END AS t3
  FROM qualifying
), b AS (
  SELECT rbind, pilotrec, LEAST(t1,t2,t3) AS best, MIN(t3) OVER (PARTITION BY rbind) AS pole
  FROM q
), s AS (
  SELECT rbind, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE best - pole < 0.2) / COUNT(*) AS pct
  FROM b WHERE pole IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rbind
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pct), 2) AS avg_qualifying_specialist_pct FROM s

WITH m AS (
  SELECT matchref,
    MAX((sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 1) AS p1_ms,
    MAX((sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::bigint) FILTER (WHERE (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 2) AS p2_ms
  FROM sprint_results
  GROUP BY matchref
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dominant_victories
FROM m
WHERE (p2_ms - p1_ms) / 1000.0 > 5
